TESS.query: one sector-coverage request per frozen coordinate; no astrocut/pixel request in T2A
TESS.selection_rule: No TESS B cadence is selected in T2A. A later cadence-manifest stage must freeze cadence IDs before reading FLUX pixels.

ZTF.eligible_triple_rule: three consecutive unique exposures in a group with both adjacent DATE-OBS gaps between 30 and 900 seconds inclusive
ZTF.pixel_rule: Freeze selected ZTF exposure identities and metadata hashes in a later commit before retrieving any sciimg/difference-image/cutout pixels.
ZTF.primary_sequence_rule: for each source with at least one eligible triple, choose the triple minimizing abs(delta_pre-232.5827)+abs(delta_post-432.2595); tie by B observation time then filefracday/field/ccdid/qid
ZTF.query: POS=<ra>,<dec>&ct=csv metadata only; no science/difference image retrieval in T2A

discovery_outputs: raw per-source metadata responses with SHA-256
purpose: Discover independent non-nuclear high-cadence archive coverage for the frozen 42-source Palomar/LUCI source universe before any T2 target pixels are opened.

source_universe.origin: 2F-E frozen exact-WCS source coordinates; source membership fixed before external archive queries

training_signature.use: ranking target only; not a physical identity claim
